name: skillshots-poc-throttled
description: Slow-3G throttled journey. Catches what fast-network testing hides — long FCP, large CSS bundles that delay first paint, JS that blocks render. Sets CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions(150ms RTT, 50 KB/s down, 50 KB/s up). Web-vitals will land in poor / needs-improvement bands if budget is exceeded.
